parameters.query:
-- Outgoing payments only, 400 days back.
-- 400 rather than 365 so an annual subscription is seen twice and can be
-- recognised as recurring rather than looking like a one-off purchase.
SELECT
    merchant_key,
    booked_at,
    ABS(amount_gbp) AS amount_gbp,
    raw_description
FROM money.transactions
WHERE amount_gbp < 0
  AND booked_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '400 days'
ORDER BY merchant_key, booked_at ASC;
